purpose: Define the human-confirmed v0 baseline controller geometry and retained ablation/reference candidates; no geometry values or generation logic changed.
left_right_semantics: Two fingers of gripper 0, identified by URDF links finger_left/finger_right; not two arms, image left/right or sorted world positions.
sampling_mode_scope: Fixed 3-by-5 finger-local sampling grid; candidate_0mm is a center-plane hypothesis, not a verified contact surface.
parameter_resolution: surface_offset_mm summarizes the unchanged current default and must equal candidates[default_candidate_id].offset_mm. An explicitly selected candidate supplies offset_mm to d=offset_mm/1000; no implicit candidate switch.

offset_direction.reference_frame: Each named finger link local frame, before Rx(pi) and world pose.
offset_direction.interpretation: Positive offset magnitude moves the left plane along local +X and the right plane along local -X. Rx(pi) leaves these X directions unchanged in the gripper root. The signed plane gap can become negative without changing point labels.

robot_pose.pose_semantics: T_world_from_eef = T_world_from_gripper_root; the supplied pose already locates the URDF root.

source.provenance_scope: Robot hash and frozen frame-113 values are inherited from the unchanged T10 contract; raw robot data is not reloaded for this static validation. Source code/URDF hashes rechecked locally.

relation_to_t10_contract.authority: T10 remains the authority for the existing single-frame result. This config records geometry candidates only; candidate_5mm and candidate_0mm do not replace its points or conclusions.

fixed_grid.point_order: Left first, then right; rows outer, columns inner.
fixed_grid.zero_offset_semantics: At 0 mm only finger-local X becomes zero. All 15 distinct Y/Z locations per finger remain; points are not collapsed to the finger origin. This is a finger-link-center-plane hypothesis.
fixed_grid.tactile_usage: None. Static URDF anchor geometry only; no tactile data, contact-based point selection or sensor features.

kinematics.world_convention: Published Deform360 annotation world frame, retained without reorientation, recentering or rescaling. Same published world convention used by the camera calibration. No global up/gravity-axis inference in T10.

candidates.semantic_description: contact-surface hypothesis; current T10 URDF-derived local X offset, not a validated physical contact surface
candidates.relation_to_t10_contract: Reproduces the existing T10 single-frame points and retains its signed-gap observation.

candidates.semantic_description: reduced inward-offset hypothesis; each plane moves 2 mm toward its finger-link center plane relative to T10
candidates.relation_to_t10_contract: Review alternative varying only the local X magnitude; no replacement or correction of T10. Reduced offset does not establish physical accuracy.

candidates.semantic_description: finger-link-center-plane hypothesis; zero local X offset with the same 15-point Y/Z grid per finger
candidates.relation_to_t10_contract: Review alternative varying only the local X magnitude; retains identities but is not the original URDF contact-anchor location.

static_validation.input_scope: Frozen pose/opening from unchanged T10 contract; no raw robot/tactile read and no other temporal frame evaluated.
static_validation.execution: Mac CPU, Python standard library; evaluate the parameterized formulas in memory for three candidates at the same frame, then pack IEEE-754 little-endian float32. No position arrays or trajectory artifact written.

continuity.offset_dependence: Affine in d at fixed pose/opening, with constant point identities and no sorting or re-sampling.
continuity.numeric_check: P(5 mm)=(2*P(0 mm)+5*P(7 mm))/7 in float64 at frame 113.
continuity.opening_dependence: Official clipping and linear joint map are continuous, with derivative changes at 0.04/0.112 m. World coordinates are continuous for continuous input poses; continuity is before float32 quantization.
continuity.scope_limit: No temporal continuity claim, no trajectory generated and no physical contact/non-penetration or graph suitability validated.

static_validation.json_dtype_note: JSON has no binary float32 type; future coordinate consumers must explicitly cast to the declared controller_dtype.

human_decision.rationale: Preserve the existing official/URDF-derived local geometry and T10 sparse representation unchanged as the v0 baseline.
human_decision.known_representation_limitation: The 7 mm offset yields negative signed plane gap in some near-closed frames; accepted as a documented representation limitation and not corrected in this stage. This does not certify physical non-penetration.
human_decision.scope: Human baseline selection only; no point, offset, identity, opening mapping or generation-logic change; no T11/T12 execution.
human_decision.review_hash_note: Earlier review metadata records the pre-confirmation config hash as historical input provenance.
